profile.headline: Software Engineer II, NAS Underwriting & Specialty Apps at Acrisure
profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer II, NAS Underwriting & Specialty Apps
profile.summary:
Hi, I'm Eric Chemwor, a software engineer with 4+ years building and shipping production systems, most recently in platform engineering at General Motors, where I led a migration to Kubernetes and OpenShift and built the CI/CD around it.
 
I work across the stack with Python, Java, and React/Next.js on top of PostgreSQL, and I'm just as comfortable in infrastructure as I am in product. Outside of that, I design and ship my own SaaS end to end, from LLM-powered features to Stripe payments to the admin platform behind them.
 
I care about clean systems, fast iteration, and turning ideas into things people can actually use. Always open to connecting with builders, engineers, and founders working on interesting problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer II, NAS Underwriting & Specialty Apps
Software Developer
positions.description:
Platform engineer focused on containerization, CI/CD, and production infrastructure modernization across automotive supply chain IT.
 
Led a multi-stage migration of production services from legacy infrastructure to Kubernetes, then to OpenShift Container Platform (OCP), containerizing the stack along the way.
Built the CI/CD pipelines around the containerized services so teams could build, test, and deploy without manual handoffs.
Migrated production databases from Oracle to PostgreSQL, cutting licensing costs by 30% and improving query performance by 20%.
Upgraded Spring Boot to 2.7.4 across services, dropping application startup time by 25%.
Drove code reviews and refactors that lifted runtime performance by 15% and reduced bug-related downtime by 20%.
Wrote internal tooling and scripts to automate repetitive build and integration work, increasing team development throughput by 10%.

positions.title: Level One Support
positions.description:
Responded to support requests from end users and patiently walked individuals through basic troubleshooting tasks with 97% satisfaction rate
Maintained response times of 20 minutes in compliance with internal policies to support business continuity.
Increased turn around time of system servers by 75%
Explained technical information in clear terms to non-technical individuals to promote better understanding. Performed root cause analysis of reported issues to decisively discern and enact corrections.
Increased inter-department communication and data sharing to close 350+ cases

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Developed Python scripts using fabric to execute remote commands on servers maintained by Popbox
Programmed a python script on VS code using I/O functions to create automated reports of results done on servers maintained by Popbox Increased productivity by using Ansible to check files on servers for old IP addresses and replaced it with new IP addresses
Collaborated with other programmers on projects using git to upload programs to Bitbucket
Practiced modular code to increase code reusability on projects
Utilized docstrings, as well as proper coding conventions, to make code more understandable for programmers

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Zip Blaze is an online store that specializes in selling earphones that have patterns on them. The company was started by Eric Chemwor as a senior in high school. As a founder, I worked on the management of ZIp Blaze by leading marketing campaigns,  inventory, and planning of operations.

positions.title: Customer Service
positions.description:
Converted unhappy customers to new Products in place of out-of-stock items
Ensured superior customer experience by addressing customer concerns, demonstrating empathy and resolving problems swiftly
Increased store corporate scores by 5 points through providing excellent customer service increasing customer satisfaction

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: TheMove is an app that helps people find parties around their area and also lets people post their own parties on it and sell tickets through there. As soon as a host post on the app everyone in the area with the app gets notified about it. Our app allows promoters to target people who party directly. This is much better than passing out fliers and wasting money on people who don’t even party.  Party hosts can sell tickets directly through the app and see how their post is performing by checking out the views( number of times the post is tapped on). The app functions as a way to help promote parties but also functions a system that will make lines go faster at clubs and parties. This in turn would allow clubs and party hosts to retain any customers that would leave due to the lines being long.
